answer: Sybil resistance through jury-consensus slashing: each answer is scored by a randomly drawn panel, and a grader is paid emission only when their verdict aligns with the finalized consensus. Seeded honeypot submissions act as a lantern that exposes collusion—approve one and your bonded stake is slashed. To force fraud through, an attacker must secretly control a panel majority as hard to amass as flawless jade; once caught, the penalty ripples across every linked identity, so each extra sock-puppet raises the capital they must lock and risk, never lowers it.
